newsitem.title: USA: Stifel Financial focuses on expenses.
newsitem.headline: Stifel Financial focuses on expenses.

text.p: Stifel Financial Corp said Monday that it continues to focus on containing its expenses.
For the third quarter, operating expenses were $21,335,000, up from $20,647,000 a year ago.
Total revenues for the quarter rose to $24,203,000 from $23,055,000. Third quarter net income was $0.10 a share, an increase from $0.04 in the 1995 period.
Nine-month 1996 earnings were $0.43 a primary share, up from $0.07 a share.

"The increased profitability over last year's three and nine month periods is a result of continued improvement in retail productivity and contributions from investment banking," George Walker III, chairman, said in a statement.
Stifel Financial is a financial services holding company with subsidiaries engaged in general securities brokerage, investment banking and money management.
